question: Kala Ramnath is associated with which of the following gharanas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mewati gharana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kala Ramnath** is associated with the **Mewati gharana**.
 
• The Mewati gharana is known for its distinctive style of classical Hindustani music.
